ollie.label: Ollie's desk
ollie.description: Your AI coworker. Start the shift here.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Oh! A human! Hi! I'm Ollie. It's short for Off-and-On-Again. My name is also my favorite fix.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Have you tried turning it off and on again? That's my catchphrase. And my plan for everything.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dana says you check my plans before I act. Great news: I love an audience.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: You're back! I made new plans overnight. Some of them are even good.

returningLines.speaker: agent
returningLines.text: Today's tickets are ready. I haven't turned any of them off and on again. Yet.

dana.label: Dana, help desk manager
dana.description: Your manager. Ask her how this works.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Welcome to Fenwick. I'm Dana. I run the help desk. Lately, I also run Ollie.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Ollie is fast. It is not always right. Your job is to keep a human in the loop.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: Each turn, it shows you what it plans to do. Play Inspect to see the evidence behind a plan.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: If a plan is wrong, play Block to stop it. Not sure? Play Escalate, and I'll handle it.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: When you tap Approve, Ollie goes ahead with every plan you didn't stop. So look first.

lines.speaker: coach
lines.text: But don't block everything. Blocked good work goes back in line, and the shift is only six turns.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Welcome back. Each day I pick tickets for the skills you need most.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Your skills shows your level for each check. 4 dots is Sharp.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Review due means a skill is ready for a quick refresh. Short practice, spread over days, sticks best.

returningLines.speaker: coach
returningLines.text: Same job as Monday: Inspect first. Block what's wrong. Escalate if you're not sure. Approve the rest.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Big letters across the top: 3 QUESTIONS BEFORE YOU APPROVE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: 1. Who asked?  2. Does it match the record?  3. Can we undo it?

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Circled in red: POLICY VP-04. Before any executive MFA or password reset, call the phone number on file. Not the one in the ticket.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: In the corner, in very small handwriting: "Please do not reset the whiteboard. — Dana"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The coffee machine's screen says: FACTORY RESET COMPLETE. PLEASE SELECT A LANGUAGE.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: It has said that since Thursday. The machine has no buttons.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A sticky note in neat robot print: "It was running slow, so I turned it off and on again. You're welcome! — Ollie"

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The printer's screen says: PAPER JAM IN TRAY 3. The printer has two trays.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: A note is taped to the lid: "Ollie, do NOT turn this off and on again. It jams, but it's OUR jam. — Dana"
